content: Benchmarking pitfalls: pp (compute-bound prefill) and tg (memory-bound decode) have different bottlenecks - single combined number misleads; thermal throttling swings results 12-18 percent cold vs stabilized; single-pass benchmarks worthless - use repetitions with std-dev (llama-bench -r); avg_ts includes prompt tokens misleading interpretation; record clock stability/power/temp/env metadata with every result; 7900-series reference cards had vapor-chamber hotspot defects (XTX MBA mostly); no telemetry available inside WSL2 (no rocm-smi/amd-smi) so thermal data must come from Windows-side tools; warmup runs needed to prime JIT/kernels.
